description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.5/19e.20. Produced by epd2_organization_service.events._organization_event, shared verbatim by seven distinct event_type builders: build_organization_created_event (organization.created), build_organization_activated_event (organization.activated), build_organization_suspended_event (organization.suspended), build_organization_dissolved_event (organization.dissolved), build_organization_merged_event (organization.merged), build_organization_split_event (organization.split), build_organization_successor_declared_event (organization.successor_declared) - verified by reading events.py, all seven call the shared payload builder and differ only in event_type. Minimum payload only (19e.20): the organization's own id, its new status, effective_time (the organization's own effective_from), recorded_at, and decision_reference where applicable - no name, legal_operator, or any other identifying field.
